facts.summary: Primary endpoint missed on blinded central review (ORR 10.2% vs 17% target) · Phase 2 · TAVO-EP plus Keytruda in anti-PD-1 refractory melanoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The primary endpoint of overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) was not met.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint of overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR) was not met.
evidence.safety: The combination therapy of TAVO™-EP and pembrolizumab was generally well tolerated with Grade 3 treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) in 4.8% of all enrolled patients.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company plans to pursue TAVO™-EP in combination with anti-PD-1 therapy in the neoadjuvant melanoma setting
